swap_tensor_module_attribute: swap a tensor attribute on a PyTorch module and return the original tensor value
swap_submodule_in_module: swap a submodule in a PyTorch module by name and return the original submodule
get_submodule_with_caching: get a nested submodule from a PyTorch module using dot-separated path with memoized lookups
swap_tensors_batched: swap multiple tensor attributes on a PyTorch module in a single batched operation
check_tensor_keys_valid: check that a set of tensor path keys are valid and report missing or unexpected keys
